method: Worker A, same AI, separate source-first pass. Reopened the adopted CIS cohort tables, restricted-choice menus and six-subject thesis-entry clause, then the actual systematic-review thesis, HCI, quantitative-content-analysis, philosophy and organisation catalogue content before comparing the finished UCR courses, schedules, relationships and audience fields. Reconsidered both positive relationships and substantive gaps rather than only replaying checks. Same AI analytical separation, not independent human review or actual rendering.
findings: The current public programme, its six themes and the adopted cohort-2026 tables establish one ordinary Dutch target pathway. Business Communication is first on the public page; the appendix orders themes differently but confirms exactly the same selected requirements. The older BDM/CC/NMD cohorts are not substituted. First-year sixty credits, thirty common plus twenty-four theme plus six restricted in year two, and thirty exchange plus eighteen restricted plus twelve thesis in year three total 180 unique credits.

Reread both restricted menus and checked the actual selected units: year-two Content Marketing and Analytics and third-year Persuasive Design, Creativity and Cognition and Misinformation and Polarization. They are permitted Spring subjects and none duplicates the Business theme or one another. Thirty exchange credits retain genuinely open approved study; no host, internship or second completed theme is invented. Zero-credit GROW and first-year subject-pool participation do not inflate the total. New course catalogue placeholders are limited to their adopted place/credits and current public subject descriptions; no detailed future outcome is invented.

The thesis is specifically a systematic literature review, with a question/theoretical framework and proposal go/no-go, independent review, discussion and oral check. The actual current entry rule is 120 programme credits including Academic Dutch, Academic English, Methodology, Statistics, Survey & Interview and Experiment. These are completed in the normal earlier two years; Content Analysis is a required course but is not a separate post-2021 thesis-entry condition. The older pre-2021 admission list is not imported.

The closest materially responds to communication through rhetoric, persuasion, meaning, media and organisational/marketing/audience inquiry. Social impact links those disciplines to public climate/health evidence, representations, movements, justice and civil society. Human/digital communication links media and language with cognition and computational tools. The latter strengthens human communication through film/media analysis and higher cognitive functions instead of rational-agent decision/optimisation study. Introductory economics is replaced by programming in the closest. Specific complementary roles are stated without turning broad business governance into strategic communication or poetic practice into interface design.

All fifty-five interests were reconciled, including twenty-one generators owned by the closest and three coherent candidate directions. The three accepted curricula change priorities as well as courses: pairwise differences are 67.5, 60 and 112.5 credits each way. Dutch-language teacher preparation is a separately evidenced direction after the three-programme maximum; no teaching qualification or fourth curriculum is claimed. Examples and possible careers do not generate programmes.

Fourteen positive relationships now follow actual subjects or specific educational functions. Rhetoric is explicitly part of Communication Theory; leadership and organisation psychology address specified organisational subjects with bounded scope; mind/technology philosophy and AI ethics address the actual philosophical questions. Stylistics is not quantitative corpus annotation, media history/representation is not UX, and international governance is not crisis/reputation communication. Twelve gaps preserve these dedicated subjects, separate experimental research, restricted specialisms, open study and the individual thesis. Optional research is additional to scheduled credits.

Read all forty-one selected course contributions and descriptions against current content, including description-only Market Research, Strategy and Digital Transformation, social movements, climate communication and psycholinguistics. All three 24-course schedules pass actual covered offerings, earlier formal prerequisites, four courses per term, first-year PPD and at least six advanced courses. Psycholinguistics occupies the sole planned Spring-2027 slot after Brain and Behaviour. Data precedes ML, ML precedes deep learning and programming precedes vision. The social-impact methods and sociology sequence is improved without inventing hard prerequisites.

Read three final labels/concepts, twenty-six external labels, seven notes, fourteen partial relationships, twelve gaps, all selected audience references and forty-one course names/descriptions through the existing renderer mapping. The clean English display title agrees with the review index while the Dutch programme identity is explicit. Exact unchanged shared description findings are reused; case roles are assessed anew. No app/renderer, workbook or enrichment change, local Shiny/browser activity, screenshots, modals, independent person or release approval is claimed.
